name: Kirin-only vendor daemons off
description: Huawei vendor daemons that only talk to Kirin hardware (touch THP, ISP and sensorhub logs, Balong modem, HiSilicon battery management, NPU, TEE/RPMB, DDR inspection, USB Type-C port, power control, media) are not started any more. On sweet they crash in a loop, eat CPU and fill the log. Their init files are removed from vendor.img. Their init cfgs also wait up to 5 s each for Kirin device nodes that never appear (about 25 s of boot time): those waits are removed.
